description: Attach an already-verified Domain to a landing page. The page must be published first (publish_landing_page); requires paid access. Pass domainId (from list_domains), or domain (hostname string) as a fallback. Mode-match rule: the Domain's hostingMode must match the page's distribution — 'postking' hostingMode only ever pairs with 'hosted' distribution, and 'self_hosted' only with 'self_hosted'. A mismatch returns a 409 whose message names which side to change; call set_landing_page_distribution or add a Domain with the matching hostingMode, then retry.

domain.description: Domain hostname to connect, e.g. 'example.com' — fallback, looked up by name under this brand. Prefer `domainId`.

domainId.description: Verified Domain ID (from list_domains). Preferred over `domain`.

name: connect_landing_page_domain
